DENNIS EASLEY's daily for SM Energy at Cold Snack Fed Com 214H is complete on every field including cascade and hydro, with one stale ELSA photo as its only item. JORDAN LEMMONS filed a complete trailer documentation set for 604 — two Trailer Inspection Forms and a Trailer Readiness Form, all ten cascade entries properly filled — with one stale alarm photo as its only item. BRIANDA SANDOVAL's Trailer Readiness Form for 602 is complete on every bottle entry. DAWSON DRAKE's Trailer Inspection Form for 272 is complete on content, with the trailer-number question above as its only item. 1099 TREVOR MCKENZIE's daily is otherwise complete

Trailer forms of both kinds, and the equipment sections of the H2S daily, are photo-based. A defect visible only in a photograph would not surface in this review. Fire extinguisher inspection and expiration dates, first aid kit dates and 4-gas calibration dates exist only inside the images, not as text, so this review confirms that a photo was taken and when, not what the photo shows.

25 of 25 submissions read. The job board email for 11/14/2026 was available and both boards were used — the ArkLaTex and Permian Basin job boards for November 2026, sheet 11-14. 32 manned board rows were checked for coverage (22 Permian, 10 ArkLaTex), of which 26 are live assignments after removing the rows marked ON STANDBY. This run started at 11:06 PM Central, before the Central day closed at midnight, so any form submitted in the final 54 minutes of 11/14 is not in these counts — missing Trailer Readiness Forms are the finding most often resolved by a late submission, and the two outstanding here (trailer 602's second inspection and trailer 139's readiness form) should be re-checked tomorrow morning before anyone is asked about them.
